# Three.js

Version 0.180.0, MIT. Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.180.0.tgz

The unmodified CommonJS distribution is wrapped as a classic script so the game remains playable through file:// without a server or network. Rebuild with `node scripts/vendor-three.cjs` after extracting the official package to `.build/three-source/package`.
